snippet.title: [Trailer] 💀HardAF, a Fast-Paced Precision Platformer, Launching on Steam June 5
snippet.description:
🔥Race through darkness with deadly precision in HardAF! This exciting 2D platformer developed by @HardBoxGames throws you into 60 intense levels, 6 epic bosses & local multiplayer (2-4 players)!

👉 Solo or Local Multiplayer Racing(2-4 players)👥
👉 Build & Share your level with the Editor ✨
👉 Climb Global Leaderboards 🏆

RELEASE ON STEAM:
🗓️ June 5 | ⏰ 12 PM GMT
🔗 Steam Page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2679880/_HardAF/
Can you survive? 😈💀
